REST API for SysAid ITSM. Manage service records (incidents, requests, problems, changes), users (agents and end users), groups, companies, assets, configuration items (CIs), templates, attachments, webhooks (beta), and license manager records. Authentication uses Client Credentials to mint short-lived application access tokens. Source: https://developers.sysaid.com/
